MINUTES
  CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  FEBRUARY 11, 2025

1.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER

MAYOR STEGURA called the meeting to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  SALUTE TO THE FLAG

Led by Sean Scott, student from Rancho Palos Verdes.

3.  ROLL CALL

City Council Members Present:  Huff, Schmitz, Stegura

City Council Members Absent:  Brown Schachter, Zerunyan

City Staff Present:  City Manager Greg Grammer
  Assistant City Attorney Steve McEwen
  Assistant City Manager Alexa Davis
  Public Works Director David Wahba
  Assistant to the City Manager Jessica Slawson

4.  CEREMONIAL ITEMS

A.  PROCLAMATION: DECLARING FEBRUARY 2025 AS AMERICAN HEART MONTH

MAYOR STEGURA declared February 2025, as American Heart Month, and invited
Providence Cardiologist and Rolling Hills Estates resident Dr. Anthony Simone to the podium
to accept the proclamation.

B.  PROCLAMATION: DECLARING FEBRUARY 2025 AS BLACK HISTORY MONTH

MAYOR STEGURA declared February 2025, as Black History Month.

5.  CONSENT CALENDAR

The following routine matters will be acted upon by one vote to approve with the majority consent of the City
Council. There will be no separate discussion of these items unless good cause is shown by a member prior to the
roll call vote. (Items removed will be considered under New Business.)

COUNCIL MEMBER SCHMITZ requested to pull item 5G from the consent calendar in order
to abstain from the vote.

  COUNCIL MEMBER SCHMITZ moved, seconded by COUNCIL MEMBER HUFF, TO
  APPROVE CONSENT CALENDAR ITEMS 5A-F, 5H-L AS FOLLOWS BY THE
  FOLLOWING ROLL CALL VOTE:

  AYES:  Huff, Schmitz, Stegura
  ABSENT:  Brown Schachter, Zerunyan

B.  READING OF ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS

  APPROVED.

C.  DEMANDS AND WARRANTS OF JANUARY & FEBRUARY 2025

  APPROVED WARRANTS 68144 THROUGH 68260 IN THE AMOUNT OF

  COMMERCIAL:  Palos Verdes Florist

FEBRUARY 11, 2025
 B.  PALOS VERDES RESERVOIR UPDATE: PRESENTED BY SHANE CHAPMAN,
  ASSISTANT GENERAL MANAGER OF OPERATIONS, METROPOLITAN WATER
  DISTRICT OF SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA

Shane Chapman, Assistant General Manager of Operations for Metropolitan Water District
provided a presentation outlining the regional water distribution system and the purpose and
service of the Palos Verdes Reservoir.

4H Club member Sean Scott provided public comment regarding the Palos Verdes Reservoir
and water availability.

7.  PUBLIC HEARINGS

None.

8.  NEW BUSINESS

A.  PALOS VERDES PENINSULA MULTI-JURISDICTIONAL HAZARD MITIGATION
  PLAN MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING AGREEMENT AND PROFESSIONAL
  SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH BLACK AND VEATCH CORPORATION FOR THE
  DEVELOPMENT OF THE PALOS VERDES PENINSULA MULTI-JURISDICTIONAL
  HAZARD MITIGATION PLAN UPDATE

  Recommendation: That the City Council: 1) Approve the Memorandum of
  Understanding Agreement between the cities of Palos Verdes Estates, Rancho Palos
  Verdes, Rolling Hills, and Rolling Hills Estates for the preparation and cost-sharing of
  the Palos Verdes Peninsula Multi-jurisdictional Hazard Mitigation Plan Update,
  approved as to form by the City Attorney, 2) Approve the Professional Services
  Agreement with Black and Veatch Corporation for the development of the Palos
  Verdes Peninsula Multi-jurisdictional Hazard Mitigation Plan Update, approved as to
  form by the City Attorney and 3) Authorize a budget adjustment for Fiscal Year 2024-
  25 in the amount of $66,544 in expenditures and $13,631 in revenue.

Assistant to the City Manager Slawson provided a staff report (as per the agenda material).

COUNCIL MEMBER SCHMITZ commended staff on their work on this project.

Assistant to the City Manager Slawson explained that City staff from all participating cities will
work together with the consultant in order to schedule the necessary community workshops, in
response to COUNCIL MEMBER HUFF.

Assistant to the City Manager Slawson explained that the process of approval from CalOES
could take several months, and that the recommended consultant plans to expedite the
process however possible, in response to MAYOR STEGURA.

Public comment was invited in-person in the Council Chamber, via email and via eComment.
No public testimony was received.

  COUNCIL MEMBER SCHMITZ moved, seconded by COUNCIL MEMBER HUFF, TO

  APPROVE THE MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING AGREEMENT

  PREPARATION AND COST-SHARING OF THE PALOS VERDES
  PENINSULA MULTI-JURISDICTIONAL HAZARD MITIGATION PLAN
  UPDATE, APPROVED AS TO FORM BY THE CITY ATTORNEY.

  AYES:  Huff, Schmitz, Stegura
  ABSENT:  Brown Schachter, Zerunyan

  COUNCIL MEMBER SCHMITZ moved, seconded by COUNCIL MEMBER HUFF, TO
  APPROVE AS FOLLOWS BY THE FOLLOWING ROLL CALL VOTE:

   APPROVE THE PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH BLACK
  AND VEATCH CORPORATION FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF THE PALOS
  VERDES PENINSULA MULTI-JURISDICTIONAL HAZARD MITIGATION
  PLAN UPDATE, APPROVED AS TO FORM BY THE CITY ATTORNEY.

  AYES:  Huff, Schmitz, Stegura
  ABSENT:  Brown Schachter, Zerunyan

  COUNCIL MEMBER SCHMITZ moved, seconded by COUNCIL MEMBER HUFF, TO
  APPROVE AS FOLLOWS BY THE FOLLOWING ROLL CALL VOTE:

  AUTHORIZE A BUDGET ADJUSTMENT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2024-25 IN THE
  AMOUNT OF $66,544 IN EXPENDITURES AND $13,631 IN REVENUE.

  AYES:  Huff, Schmitz, Stegura
  ABSENT:  Brown Schachter, Zerunyan

9.  OLD BUSINESS

A.  NOTICE OF COMPLETION - FOUNDERS PARK (PHASE 2) - KORMEX
  CONSTRUCTION, INC.

  Recommendation: That the City Council: 1) Accept Phase 2 of Founders Park
  completed by Kormex Construction Inc. as complete, 2) Approve the change orders
  for the Project in the amount of $25,800, 3) Authorize the City Clerk to file the Notice

  claims are filed within 35 days after recordation, direct staff to release the 5%
  construction retention payment to Kormex Construction, Inc. in the amount of
  $4,242.50.

Public Works Director Wahba provided a staff report (as per the agenda material).

Public comment was invited in-person in the Council Chambers, via email and via eComment.
No public testimony was received.

  COUNCIL MEMBER SCHMITZ moved, seconded by COUNCIL MEMBER HUFF, TO
  APPROVE AS FOLLOWS:

  1) ACCEPT PHASE 2 OF FOUNDERS PARK COMPLETED BY KORMEX
  CONSTRUCTION INC. AS COMPLETE, 2) APPROVE THE CHANGE
  ORDERS FOR THE PROJECT IN THE AMOUNT OF $25,800, 3) AUTHORIZE
  THE CITY CLERK TO FILE THE NOTICE OF COMPLETION (NOC) WITH THE
  LOS ANGELES COUNTY RECORDER’S OFFICE, AND 4) IF NO CLAIMS ARE
  FILED WITHIN 35 DAYS AFTER RECORDATION, DIRECT STAFF TO
  RELEASE THE 5% CONSTRUCTION RETENTION PAYMENT TO KORMEX
  CONSTRUCTION, INC. IN THE AMOUNT OF $4,242.50.

  AYES:  Huff, Schmitz, Stegura
  ABSENT:  Brown Schachter, Zerunyan
